sources.title: opd-teacher-Q2.5I-LinkBeads-step149 - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: opd-teacher-Q2.5I-LinkBeads-step149 This is a Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct teacher trained with RLVE on the LinkBeads environment at difficulty 0. It is intended for the 32-environment on-policy distillation experiment. The model was trained for 150 updates with GRPO. step149 is the final, zero-based checkpoint index (the 150th update).
